screen.evaluable: All twelve original specified endpoints, selected modes, role and initial-function custody, fixed solver receipts and finite outputs available. No substituted survivors. Convergence and cap terminations remain explicit.
full_specific_opportunity: fullBE served accuracy exceeds factorBE in each of three seeds
Equal-seed mean pooled NLL no worse
Equal-seed mean member and worst-member accuracy no worse
coverage_opportunity: More actual new correct member alternatives on native all-wrong nodes in every seed
Positive equal-seed mean global any-correct gain
Positive equal-seed mean excess actual pooled repairs on native all-wrong/common-rival nodes
weakness_remedied_in_frozen_diagnostic: Equal-seed mean served accuracy meets or exceeds untouched ordinary native AND ordinary full refit
Mean pooled NLL no worse than each of those ordinary references
Report every paired seed, all remaining gaps and single full refit

decisions.no_full_specific_signal: No automatic retrial, grid or expensive extension. Retain outcome and limits.
decisions.partial_frozen_head_opportunity: If the full-specific and coverage conditions pass but ordinary stays stronger, report the remaining gap. A separate scientific proposal may justify one full from-scratch comparison, based on effect, costs and the active context/attribution findings. No automatic fit admission.
decisions.frozen_weakness_remedied: Consider one known zero-initialized private task-head extension from scratch with shared backbone and complete strong references. Still requires unused confirmation and closest-prior comparison.

nonconvergence: Preserve finite capped endpoints and every failure. If a comparative optimization failure is unresolved, no affirmative complete opportunity screen. No strict capacity inference from nonglobal factor fits in any case.
